identity.hoa_name: GABLES BY THE SEA HOMEOWNERS' ASSOCIATION, INC.
identity.notes: Guard-gated, waterfront residential neighborhood established in 1957 along the southern coastal boundary of Coral Gables and Pinecrest, Miami-Dade County, FL. Comprises approximately 520 custom-built single-family estates with canal-front homes, private docks, and deep-water marine/bay access. The community is split between the City of Coral Gables and the Village of Pinecrest under a dual-municipal design. Entry price starts at $1.5M+ with a median sale price of $4.3M and trophy-tier bayfront estates up to $28M. The voluntary HOA (Florida not-for-profit corporation, active since 1964) focuses on security and neighborhood standards. HOA office: 944 San Pedro Ave, Miami FL 33156. Management company: FPMS, Sarasota FL. Website: gablesbythesea.org / gablesbytheseafl.com.

fees.note: Modest annual amount referenced in some property listings; association described as voluntary with optional contributions rather than mandatory large dues. No special assessments or monthly/quarterly/transfer/capital contribution fees publicly detailed. Confidence limited — no official fee schedule found.
HOA fee field listed in directory but no specific amount provided. Property Manager: FPMS, 5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota FL 34231, 941-960-5000. HOA est. 03/30/1964, Federal ID 592090965.

Mandatory security guard assessment of $1,047 to $1,450 annually, levied through special taxing districts (1995 county-administered district was abolished by resident vote in 2022 and split into two municipal districts under Coral Gables and Pinecrest; dual guard houses at SW 128th and SW 134th Streets). No CDD identified in sources read; this is a municipal security tax district assessment, not a CDD charge. Range reported as-is; exact per-parcel amount varies and was not itemized on the page. Amount field left null because the page gives a range rather than a single figure. Voluntary HOA dues separately described as 'nominal' with no amount published (see second fee fact). Retrieved 2026-10-01 (approx.). Confidence 0.85 (official community site). HOA office per florida-hoa.net: 944 San Pedro Ave, Miami FL 33156; manager FPMS, 5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota FL 34231, 941-960-5000; HOA website gablesbythesea.org (site itself could not be read). HOA is a Florida not-for-profit corp active since 1964 (FED ID 592090965).
Voluntary HOA: dues described only as 'nominal'; no dollar amount published on the official site. Association focuses on security and neighborhood standards without club-style amenities.

HOA bulletin board summary: 'some property listings reference modest annual amounts around $1,350' while multiple sources describe the association as voluntary with optional contributions rather than mandatory dues. Exact current fee schedule not publicly detailed. A search snippet from the same site also claimed 'historically around $100-$150 per year on a volunteer basis', which I could not confirm in the page body I read; treat $1,350 and $100-150/yr as conflicting versions. Mailing address listed: P.O. Box 560927, Miami FL 33156.

amenities.detail: 24/7 resident-controlled guard security; community is a guard-gated waterfront neighborhood
Canal-front homes with private docks and direct bay access; strategic position for yacht owners; canal-front properties trade $3.0M–$8.0M, trophy bayfront peninsulas up to $28M
Features a playground, basketball courts, and tennis courts
Additional recreational options available at nearby public parks

24/7 guard-gated community; dual guardhouse entries at SW 128th and SW 134th Streets; strictly pre-authorized visitor access; roving patrols. Established 1957; ~520 custom single-family estates split between Coral Gables and Pinecrest (dual-municipal).

Bridge-free direct access to Biscayne Bay from eastern saltwater canals; canal drafts up to 9 ft; private residential docks with up to 100+ linear feet of frontage on custom seawalls; $0 municipal slip fees; Miami-Dade DERM Class I permitting. Note: Section C freshwater canals are restricted by an earthen salinity dam.

Security historically managed under a single county-administered taxing district created in 1995; in 2022 residents voted to abolish it and split it into two distinct municipal districts (Coral Gables and Pinecrest), which maintain the dual guard houses.

Amenities center on the gated entrance with 24/7 guard security and a community park featuring a playground, basketball, and tennis courts; no large-scale club-style amenities. HOA focuses on security, standards, and waterways advisory board participation.

'Families enjoy living in Gables by the Sea, thanks to a large playground for children'; described as one of the oldest gated waterfront communities within Coral Gables, just off scenic Old Cutler Road, bordered to the north by the R. Hardy Matheson County Preserve. Lots ~9,900-35,000+ sq ft; homes 1,661-9,295 sq ft built 1957-2018; resort-style pools, docks, spas typical in-home amenities.

'There are no shopping streets or public parks within the community itself'; not a traditional HOA with large monthly dues tied to shared amenities; no mandatory club memberships; residents rely on nearby Pinecrest, Coral Gables, and South Miami for dining, groceries, and errands.

Most properties are within FEMA-designated coastal flood zones; flood insurance typically required for financed purchases. Seawalls are generally the individual homeowner's responsibility, not the HOA's.

demographics.geography_level: Gables By The Sea - Coral Bay (census populated-place micro-neighborhood within City of Coral Gables; does not exactly match the dual-municipal community boundary - Pinecrest side not separately profiled in sources read). Source: 2019-2023 ACS 5-year estimates as compiled by Point2Homes Research Team. Note: page states median household income is 2024 data per US Census Bureau while the underlying file is ACS 2019-2023. Also on page: 420 households (avg 3 members), 457 housing units, 58.2% detached single-family, median construction year 1973, median gross rent $1,951, 2.9% unemployment. A different point2homes page showed 32,582 residents/median age 42.1 for a similarly named area - treated as a data error; the 1,166 figure is used here. Confidence 0.6 (aggregator citing Census/ACS). City-level context: Coral Gables city population 49,802 (https://censusreporter.org/profiles/16000US1214250-coral-gables-fl/, confidence 0.7, data year not stated on page).

open_questions: Official HOA website gablesbythesea.org could not be read (3 attempts, page would not render) - current dues schedule, bylaws, rules, and annual reports could not be verified directly; florida-hoa.net and floridacommunitynetwork.net list it as the association website and state 'HOA Fee Required' but publish no amount.

CommunityPay's search snippet claims 'Median fee $383/mo' and 'Very High' risk with 19 disclosures under Fla. Stat. 720.30851 for this HOA, but the page content I actually read showed only boilerplate compliance checklists with no fee figure - this conflicting fee claim is unverified and should be checked directly.

Exact per-parcel security assessment amount: official site gives only a $1,047-$1,450 annual range; current-year millage rates for the two post-2022 municipal security districts (Coral Gables / Pinecrest) were not found in sources read.

No CDD was identified for this community in any source read; the special assessment appears to be a municipal security tax district (created 1995 as county-administered, restructured 2022) rather than a Community Development District - confirm whether any CDD overlay exists.

Pet policy, rental restrictions, architectural/lot-coverage guidelines, and transfer fees are not published in the sources read (hoabulletinboard explicitly states these details are not publicly available) - request estoppel and rules from FPMS (941-960-5000) or the HOA office at 944 San Pedro Ave, Miami FL 33156 / P.O. Box 560927.
Residence count conflict: official site and buyer notes say ~520 estates; allinmiami.com and hoabulletinboard.com say ~360 custom homes (0.5 sq mi per allinmiami).

No community pool, clubhouse, fitness center, or golf course was found in any public source; recreation appears to rely on the small community park (playground, basketball, tennis) and nearby public venues such as Matheson Hammock Park's atoll pool (~5-7 min) - confirm with the HOA whether any private amenities exist.

Mile distances to the nearest grocery, shopping centers, and libraries were not stated on any page read (only drive times: Suniland/Publix-etc. ~9 min, Pinecrest Branch Library address confirmed but no distance); the ~2-3 mile estimates for Pinecrest Branch and Old Cutler Town Center Publix are geographic inferences, not sourced figures.

allinmiami's claim that Nicklaus Children's Hospital sits 'within the perimeter' of Suniland Shopping Center (Pinecrest) appears geographically wrong (Nicklaus is in NW Miami); treat hospital proximity per the official site (South Miami Hospital 5.0 mi, Baptist 6.1 mi) until verified.

Demographic data unit 'Gables By The Sea - Coral Bay' (pop. 1,166, median age 42, 73.6% owner-occupied, median HH income $137,076) is a census populated-place that does not exactly match the dual-municipal community; no ACS profile was found for the Pinecrest-side portion of the community.

hoabulletinboard cites ~360 homes and a location 'along Old Cutler Road near Matheson Hammock Park'; jillszeder says southeast of Pinecrest and north of Deering Bay - minor location descriptions differ; community footprint was not independently mapped in sources read.
